name: sendnew-agent
description: Menu-bar agent that connects a Mac mini to the SendNew server and drives Messages.app/FaceTime.

scripts.start: if [ -d .electron-dist ]; then printf 'Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron' > node_modules/electron/path.txt; ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH="$(pwd)/.electron-dist" electron .; else electron .; fi

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: SendNew Agent sends iMessages and starts FaceTime calls on your behalf via Messages.app and FaceTime.app.
